package.name: visp_pbvs_servo
package.description: TS4 — visual servoing with a depth-scaled lateral channel. Shared FSM (servo_core) plus a hand-written law in src/pbvs_controller.cpp. It is a MIXED law, not an all-metric one: only vy is metric (depth-scaled), while vx is bbox-ratio and vz is normalized pixel error. Despite the package name this uses NO ViSP: no interaction matrix, no pseudo-inverse. The name is historical and is kept because the stack configs and launch files key on it.
